TIME_SOURCE: independently pinned monotonic source; no workload clock certification
UNKNOWN_DESCENDANT_POLICY: qualification failure/unknown, consumed authority remains unavailable
UNRESOLVED_ASSUMPTIONS: kernel kill/membership trust root and actual permission
